hypothesis: A CRS presentation that always exposes center, left tail, right tail, and coverage mass will reduce information loss caused by Top-N-only presentation without changing the underlying probability model.

reject_or_rework_if: The presentation silently drops TTG 0-1 or 4+ probability mass metadata.
The displayed exact-score subset is mislabeled as the complete CRS distribution.
OTHER_H/D/A buckets are assigned fabricated totals or margins.
The presentation causes automatic production/staking promotion without separate OOS evidence.
falsification_contract.promotion_requirement: No model promotion. Any decision-value claim requires preregistered OOS evaluation.
